(R) Every spot inside the scene is the fork's generated layout, not an original one. Zone number 1200 is the fork's; ours must be assigned and the scene sg_random_encounter_clearing has not been loaded by our server yet (the eleven shipped battles all use sg_random_encounter_clearing). Triggers: at-start spawns are actors, later waves follow the one before (the fork's 1.5 s delay is dropped). Knockouts and score are the design's defaults; coins and XP are the shipped battles' values, not the fork's 15 coins / 100 stars.

(R) rc-0136 (2026-11-11): the Snarlers that fight (the battle's waves, and the quest-gated field one) wear model 177 wolf_evil.adr, the Frostfang family's body (card 78097 'A pack of hungry wolves'; the fork's waves are Frostfang Wolves). The den sg_spawner_wolf_01.adr (1938) is the battle starter's look, as 2014 drew it.

(R) Not proven in the client: this scene needs one native load, and the starter or door of `entry` is drawn by the entrances work, not by this file. Each kind's rank here decides its health and hit at the fight's tier.

(R) rc-0136 (2026-11-11): this row is the battle's starter, the prop 2014 drew it as (the Snarler's den: video 5-IM2pBh2yY frames 01048 and 01080, red name, crossed swords, Press X; capture p12 t=546051.7 model 1938). The fight's own kind carries the body its waves fight with.
